facts.fact: BEAC Instruction n°002/GR/2026 of 5 May 2026 on pre-financing of inbound remittances through payment institutions supplements CEMAC Regulation n°04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC of 21 December 2018 on payment services in the CEMAC, with sanctions for breach, so binding rules on payment services apply across the CEMAC (the article names no country; Gabon is a CEMAC member).
facts.system: CEMAC Regulation n°04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC on payment services (2018)

facts.fact: The 2018 CEMAC payment-services regulation, as supplemented by BEAC Instruction n°002/GR/2026 of 5 May 2026, governs payment institutions (établissements de paiement) distinct from credit institutions, which the instruction obliges to report monthly to the central bank and subjects to penalties; the article names no country.
facts.system: CEMAC Regulation n°04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC on payment services (2018)
